gter gzhung zab rling dbang po rab spyod la/ /zur 'debs lhan thabs dgos pa dben na yang*/ /dang po'i las can dag la dgos par sems/ /de phyir rtsa gsum

tei:div.tei:p: gter gzhung zab rling dbang po rab spyod la// zur 'debs lhan thabs dgos pa dben na yang*// dang po'i las can dag la dgos par sems// de phyir rtsa gsum lha yis gnang ba stsol// rang bzo'i bcos bslad gyur na bzod par gsol// zhabs tog mdzes pa'i rgyan des shis pa stsol// 'gugs pa'i zur 'debs ni/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas dmigs pa rtse gcig pas/ na mo/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam zab pa skor bdun gyi dkyil 'khor zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ phrin las kyi rtsa ba dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can chos srung dgongs 'dus kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i mthu stobs nus pa la brten nas/ chos mdzad yongs la sgab 'drer sdang zhing snod bcud mnga' thang nyams par byed pa/ bse rag rgyal mo kha dgu mtshang can/ btsa' byed mig dmar/ than byed kha skya/ sad byed lag rdum/ skyi 'dang sha sgal/ lcags thil sngon po/ a mgo chang rkun/ bhe nya zho rkun/ bsnyab pa lag ring*/ the'u rang stong 'khrug sogs ltog 'gong dbul sri thams cad glud gzugs yas stags 'di la khug cig /sme brtsegs kyi sngags mthar/ ltog 'dre dbul sri thams cad a karṣā ya dzaḥ zhes gsum mam bdun sogs dang sbyar/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ yas rdzas rnams byin brlabs shing bsngo sbyang gyer ro// 'gugs pa'i lhan thabs shig bri bar sems pa'i skabs su dkar po dge bshes padma sa bcu'i bskul ngor/ gter blon ratnas bris pa dza yantu/// /
